scripts.dev:silent: node scripts/db-update-helper.mjs && SILENT=true node scripts/dev.mjs dev:silent
scripts.AHCC:silent: node scripts/db-update-helper.mjs && SILENT=true node scripts/dev.mjs dev:silent
scripts.AHCC:cluster: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "pnpm update-db; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $root = Get-Location; $jobs = @(); $jobs += Start-Job -ArgumentList $root { param($r) Set-Location $r; pnpm -C apps/backend dev:cluster }; $jobs += Start-Job -ArgumentList $root { param($r) Set-Location $r; pnpm -C apps/frontend dev }; $jobs | Receive-Job -Wait -AutoRemoveJob"
